verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a CLI, an MCP server, agent skills and a dashboard agent, but these are separate interfaces, not the documented public API this story asks about. No item describes a public HTTP or GraphQL API with reference docs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A public API is a fair axis for a cloud platform, so the absence of evidence is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
